entities.summary: Andean, a notable figure in the history of Peru, associated with Regional Kingdoms: Nazca, Moche, Wari, and Chimú (600–1438). Preceded by Wari Empire and Chan Chan built — largest adobe city in the world, Chimú capital. Their legacy influenced Discovery of Lord of Sipán's tomb — 1987, 'King Tut of the Americas' and Inca Origins and the Kingdom of Cusco.
